family.description: This family consists of several Baculovirus proteins of around 55 residues in length. Family members include Autographa californica nuclear polyhedrosis virus (AcMNPV) Per os infectivity factor AC110, which is required for oral infectivity. It may play a role after occlusion-derived virions pass through the host's peritrophic membrane [[cite:PUB00082597]].
family.name: Per os infectivity factor AC110
